title: fix(app-shell): a reaction click keeps every other user's stored reaction ids (objectui#11019)
body:
Fixes #11019
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`sys_comment.reactions` stores `{ emoji: userIds[] }`. A reaction click writes the comment's whole reaction set back with one `sys_comment` `update`. The read in `RecordDetailView` kept only `{ emoji, count, reacted }` per emoji, so the write rebuilt each list from them in `storedReactionShape`: the clicker's id when they had reacted, then a literal `'__other__'` up to the count. The first click by anyone replaced every other user's id on every emoji of the comment.

Premise check on `origin/main` `0eb9f36`: the card's snippets still match. `storedReactionShape` was where PR objectui#11017 put it, and the write called it for every click.

## What changed (`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`)

- **The read keeps the stored ids.** `parseReactions` puts each emoji's stored list on the reaction as `userIds`. That slot is already declared on `Reaction` in `@object-ui/types` ("IDs of users who reacted"), and nothing filled it before. `count` and `reacted` are derived from those ids exactly as before.
- **The toggle changes only the clicker's id.** `toggleOwnReaction(reactions, emoji, userId)` adds the clicker's id to that emoji's stored ids, or takes it out. Every other id on that emoji and on every other emoji is kept. An emoji left with no ids is dropped. That matches the read, which renders an empty stored list as a zero chip and shows a missing key as nothing.
- **The write stores those ids.** `storedReactions` replaces `storedReactionShape`, and the rebuild and its "single-user pilot" comment are gone. There is no `'__other__'` padding and no list rebuilt from a count.
- **A reaction without stored ids is refused, not guessed.** `storedUserIds` throws instead of writing an empty or made-up list. Only the read and the toggle produce reactions on this slice, and both set `userIds`, so this path is unreachable today. It stays loud so that a future producer cannot silently bring back the erasure.

**Kept from the read vs. re-read before the write:** I kept the ids from the read. They ride inside each click's step in PR objectui#11017's rollback ledger, so a rollback restores the ids along with the counts. The ledger's contract ("each write stores the row's whole set as of its click") is unchanged. A re-read would have added one `find` per click and a second async edge inside that ledger, and it would not remove the race below.

**Residue, stated and not addressed here (per triage):** two people reacting at the same moment still means the later write wins. A server-side toggle (direction A) is not filed.

## Rows an earlier build already wrote (`'__other__'`)

Measured through the pins below, with the real panel reading the stored JSON:
- The read counts each `'__other__'` entry as one reaction by someone else. `{"👍": ["__other__", "__other__"]}` shows `👍 2`, not the clicker's own. It is never counted as the clicker, since `reacted` is still `userIds.includes(currentUser.id)`.
- The new write keeps these entries exactly as stored. Adding gives `["__other__", "__other__", "u1"]`, and taking back `u1` from `["u1", "__other__"]` leaves `["__other__"]`.
- The ids they replaced are gone and are not recovered. For example, a user whose id was padded away still reads as not having reacted, so their click adds a reaction.

## Tests

New `RecordDetailView.reactionKeepIds-11019.test.tsx` (real `RecordDetailView` and real `ReactionPicker`, fake data source, signed-in user varied):
1. Triage's pin. The row is seeded `{"👍": ["u2", "u3"]}`. `u1` adds ❤️ and the write is `{"👍": ["u2", "u3"], "❤️": ["u1"]}`. `u1` then adds 👍 and the write is `{"👍": ["u2", "u3", "u1"], "❤️": ["u1"]}`. Re-mounted as `u2` over that stored value, 👍 reads as `u2`'s own. `u2`'s click writes `{"👍": ["u3", "u1"], "❤️": ["u1"]}`, removing `u2` and nothing else.
2. Stored `'__other__'` entries are kept and never counted as the clicker.
3. Taking back the last id of an emoji drops that emoji from the write and keeps the others.

PR objectui#11017's `RecordDetailView.reactionWriteFailure-10899.test.tsx` (6 pins: rollback, StrictMode single write, localized error) is unchanged and green.

**Ablation (one-off, not kept):** the fix was committed first (`15c3d88`). Then `RecordDetailView.tsx` was checked out from the base `0eb9f36`. On disk after that, `storedReactionShape` was found 3 times and `storedUserIds` 0 times, and the file hash equalled the base blob. The new file went red on all 3 pins. For example, pin 3 received `{"🎉": ["__other__", "__other__"]}` where it expected `{"🎉": ["u2", "u3"]}`. The 6 objectui#10899 pins stayed green. The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, its hash equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Local gates (final head `f868b52`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the 36 test files that import `RecordDetailView`, in two batches. Batch B has 18 files and 116 tests, both reaction files among them, and passed at `f868b52`. Batch A has the other 18 files and 123 tests, and passed at `15c3d88`. Between those two commits the only diff is a removed unused import in the new test file, which is not in batch A, and `RecordDetailView.tsx` is byte-identical.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exits 0 at `f868b52`, after building the dependency closure with `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (28 tasks). `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test file (`--listFilesOnly`).
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the two changed source files gives 0 errors. `RecordDetailView.tsx` has 111 warnings, the same as at base. The new test file has 4 `no-explicit-any` warnings, in the same style as its objectui#10899 sibling.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-claims` and `check-pending-changeset-literals` all exit 0. `check-changeset-claims` points at pending `.changeset/7997-detail-view-related-retired.md`, which names this file. I read that paragraph: it is about the retired `DetailView.related` schema and is still true after this diff.
- **Declared narrowing:** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/` (562 files) did not finish inside the 570s foreground cap. It was stopped by `timeout` with exit 124 and is NOT MEASURED locally. The narrowing above is the set of test files that import `RecordDetailView`, which is where the changed functions live. None of the changed functions is exported. The full farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, measured once with a one-off probe (not committed):** an activity row (`sys_activity`) on a record page's discussion panel also offers "Add reaction". Picking 👍 on it sends `update('sys_comment', 'a1', { reactions: '{"👍":["u1"]}' })`, which writes a `sys_comment` row by a `sys_activity` id. This is handed to the seat in the report and not addressed here.
- **Out of scope, read only:** objectstack's `sys_comment.reactions` field (`plugin-audit`, `Field.textarea`) is described as "JSON array of emoji reaction objects". The only producer and reader, this file, stores `{ emoji: userIds[] }`. This is handed to the seat in the report.
